title: Register CAP-INV-101 bounded runtime claim and refresh readiness
goal: Add exactly one VERIFIED CAP-INV-101 Case Queue read-only runtime claim sourced from E10-INV-101F into the global implementation ledger, validate the manifest/handoff evidence floors and recompute readiness. Do not equate bounded implementation with full capability completion.
inputs: E10-INV-101F VERIFIED runtime handoff and closure-evidence.json
Product Spec baseline and active capability register
invariants: canonical Product Spec and runtime are read-only
the F handoff must remain source-backed and satisfy strict RuntimeImplementationHandoff schema
CAP-INV-101 ledger entry only once, independently verified against manifest and runtime ownership
full-capability completion or production readiness is not claimed
OPEN-013 remains unresolved, export/mutation/provider/final UI excluded
security_properties: zero runtime dependency and cross-boundary-edge claims are verified, not invented
false or inaccessible capability evidence blocks ledger registration
TENANT and Saved View authorization behavior remains unchanged

rollback.strategy: revert only ledger and scaling metadata, preserving all verified runtimes

definition_of_done: CAP-INV-101 exists once in verified global ledger
fresh readiness snapshot identifies next candidates
